description.en: Makes a match team learn a tactic by ID, looked up by team slot, and flags the newly learned tactic for the in-match learning popup (if the team has fewer than 32 known tactics).
Index of the team/side to teach the tactic to.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 2 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Teach team 0 a new tactic during a scripted match sequence
CMND_BTL_LEARNING_TACTICS(0, "wht0004");
